dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: I wonder how many hounds it takes to make a sled catch up to a train...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you want to go sledding?

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: Of course! Just... don't tell my dad. He always says it's super, super dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: Over there. He usually helps Alyosha maintain his workbench.

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I wanted to use Alyosha's workbench to craft a hunting rifle, but Dad said no right away. Even though Alyosha had already agreed...

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: If I get the chance, I'm just going to borrow Alyosha's rifle to play with instead...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe a sled isn't that dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: Right? I've always wanted to modify a sled so I could actually catch up to a train!

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: But when Dad found out, he banned me from touching sleds ever again, and he's been telling me how super, super dangerous they are...
